denominator.definition: Occurrences of markdown links, bare http(s) URLs, and mailto links in git-tracked .md .py .toml files. build/ and virtualenvs are not tracked and are omitted.
denominator.note: link_occurrences counts tracked-file link syntax only. diagnostic_references is a separate list, not added into link_occurrences, and not counted as broken customer links.

classification_note: diagnostic_references is a separate list, not link rows. Those items are evidence targets. Their historical 401, DNS, or invite results are not broken customer links.
